ncfc73wx.baseName: Neo 60cm Set of 2 LED Pre-Lit Birch Twig Tree Lights 60cm - Battery Operated
ncfc73wx.variantName: Neo 60cm Set of 2 LED Pre-Lit Birch Twig Tree Lights 60cm - Battery Operated
ncfc73wx.sourceDescription: Add a warm and inviting glow to your home with the Neo 60cm Pre-Lit Birch Twig Tree Set of Featuring realistic white birch-effect trunks, delicate branches and soft warm white LED lights, these decorative trees create an elegant lighting display suitable for everyday home décor, Christmas celebrations, weddings and special occasions. Designed with flexible, bendable branches, each artificial twig tree can be shaped and styled to suit your preferred display. Leave the branches bare for a minimalist look or decorate them with lightweight ornaments, jewellery and seasonal accessories. The realistic bark texture and warm LED illumination make these trees a beautiful decorative feature for living rooms, bedrooms, hallways, dining tables and office spaces. The battery-powered design allows convenient placement without the need for a nearby mains socket, making the trees ideal for table centrepieces, mantelpieces, bedside tables and festive displays. Each tree stands 60cm tall and features a sturdy square base measuring 10cm x 10cm, providing a compact and stable decorative arrangement. Whether used as Christmas twig trees, decorative accent lights, wedding wishing trees or jewellery displays, this versatile two-piece set adds a stylish finishing touch to any interior. Product Specifications Brand: Neo Product Type: Pre-Lit LED Birch Twig Trees Colour: White Birch Effect Light Colour: Warm White Lighting Type: Integrated LED Lights Power Source: Battery Powered Branch Design: Flexible, bendable branches for customisable shaping Finish: Realistic white birch bark-effect texture Base: Square freestanding base Suitable For: Indoor decorative use Ideal Uses: Christmas decorations, wedding centrepieces, bedroom lighting, table displays, mantelpiece decorations and jewellery displays Design Style: Minimalist, natural and contemporary Product Dimensions Each Birch Twig Tree: Height (H): 60 cm Width (W): 10 cm (base) Depth (D): 10 cm (base) Length (L): 10 cm (base) Set Includes: 2 x 60cm Pre-Lit Birch Twig Trees This product is intended for indoor decorative use only and is not a toy. Keep out of reach of young children and pets to prevent injury or accidental ingestion of small parts. Always place the twig trees on a stable, flat surface away from open flames, heat sources and flammable materials. Do not expose the product to water, excessive moisture or extreme temperatures. Use only the recommended battery type and ensure batteries are inserted correctly, observing the correct polarity. Do not mix old and new batteries or different battery types. Remove batteries when the product is not in use for extended periods and dispose of used batteries safely. Keep batteries and the battery compartment secure and out of reach of children. Take care when bending or adjusting the flexible branches to avoid damage to the wiring or LED lights. Do not pull, cut or excessively twist the branches. Regularly inspect the product for signs of damage, exposed wires or loose components. Do not use if damaged or malfunctioning. Switch off when unattended and always follow the manufacturer's instructions for safe operation, maintenance and storage. Failure to follow these precautions may result in injury, electric shock or fire. Neo Direct Ltd, Butterley Street, Leeds, LS10 1AW, England, United Kingdom

gvcq846z.variantName: Walplus 112 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - Cool White - 182 cm
gvcq846z.sourceDescription: This LED Christmas Tree with Spikes elevates your holiday decor with dynamic lighting patterns and a sleek modern design fit for both indoor and sheltered outdoor settings. Designed for those looking to enhance their festive display, this tree blends seamlessly with a variety of settings, from living rooms to garden spaces. Artfully crafted from metal, it presents an enduring piece that withstands the seasonal wear and tear, adding a lively touch to your festive celebrations. Dynamic Lighting Effects The LED Christmas Tree offers dynamic lighting that continuously changes patterns, creating a captivating visual display. With eight modes, you can personalize how your tree lights up the holidays, turning ordinary moments into memorable events. USB-Powered Convenience This tree is engineered to be powered through USB, making it versatile and convenient for use without traditional power adapters. Simply plug it into any USB port, whether it's a power bank, computer, or adapter, for instant festive illumination. Durable Metal Construction Built with solid metal, the tree provides a robust structure that is abrasion resistant. This choice in material extends the product's life, even in high traffic locations, ensuring it remains part of your seasonal decor for many future gatherings. Versatile Use Suitable for both the living room and sheltered outdoor spaces like patios or terraces, this tree adapts well to various environments, offering consistent festive charm whether displayed in a cozy nook or open veranda. Simple Care and Maintenance To maintain its quality appearance, a simple wipe with a dry cloth is all it takes. This ease of maintenance heightens user convenience, allowing more time for enjoyment rather than upkeep. Product Specifications Colour: Cool white Material: Metal Tree height: 182 cm Durable Lights type: Decorative string lights Lights color: Cool white Number of LEDs: 112 LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Cable length: 500 cm Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x LED christmas tree This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd
